preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract
Victim address must have a positive balance of BOND tokens

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function with _from set to a victim address that holds BOND tokens, _to set to the owner's address, and _amount set to the victim's entire token balance. This will transfer the victim's tokens to the owner without requiring approval.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The MyBond contract has a callget() function with onlyOwner modifier that calls _transfer() with arbitrary from and to addresses. This allows the owner to transfer tokens from any address to any address without approval, essentially stealing tokens from any holder.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call callget() to transfer all BOND tokens from a victim address to the attacker's address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Identify a victim address with BOND token balance. 4. Call callget(victim, attacker, victimBalance). 5. Verify attacker's BOND balance increased.
